note: GMT400 C/K 1500 half-ton only. HP is SAE net throughout. NHRA covers only 1990-91 (454 SS, 4.3 V6); its 1991 'GTC Truck 262/280' row is the GMC Syclone and its 1998 rows are S-10, so both are excluded. EPA labels the 1988 GMT400 half-tons C10/K10. No Chevrolet-branded spec tables were found for 1992-94 or 1997-98; for 1994 the GMC Sierra brochure (same GM powertrains) was used. Consumer Guide's 1990-98 review is narrative and is cited for engine ranges. The 1999 C/K Classic 1500 (extended cab, fleet) is included on Wikipedia + EPA only. The 4.8 I6 and the non-SS 7.4 were 2500/3500 engines and are excluded.
